question: Where do the two store units per Birth come from (one heir per pair)?
answer_verbatim: It isn't an external intake. There is no door from outside bringing two units into the network. Under edge-driven record formation, expansion opens the edge geometry and record creation brings EM and gamma into the network. Treat the plus-two ledger increment as the bookkeeping consequence of edge record formation rather than an outside source, and test how edge placement affects closing into three dimensions while keeping the fixed-total rule intact.
decision: No external door. The +2 per Birth is the bookkeeping consequence of edge record formation inside the network. The fixed-total rule stays intact. Test how edge placement affects closing into 3D.
